subject: done椭圆塔眩晕
body: 改动: config.js:127 oval原生range=260保留+stunChance=5+描述补眩晕 | skills.js:114 EFFECT_KEYS.stunChance,214-219 oval_stun(眩晕射击 base5 per5,概率=5%x技能等级),852-853 NATIVE_GETTERS | enemy.js:10 STUN_DURATION=1.0,67 stunTimer初始化,88-98 isStunned/applyStun(单debuff刷新不叠加),101-109 updateEnemy眩晕冻结(不推进不判定到达=不能移动+不能攻击),143导出 | tower.js:360-367 getStunChance=原生+技能增量,694导出 | game_core.js:761-769 applyDamage oval分支命中roll点挂眩晕 | bonusStats面板眩晕几率行+theme glyph. 射程来源: TOWER_STATS.oval.range=260原生HEAD已存在,技能oval_range(base260/per15)替换为眩晕后range恒260,未砍射程;damage12/crit0/critMult2/penetration0未动. 概率抽查: Lv1=5 Lv2=10 Lv3=15 Lv4=20 Lv5=25 Lv6=30(=5%xLv);实塔getStunChance Lv1=5 Lv6(enhance5)=30. 验证: skills.audit=[] stage.audit=[] requireOK(config/skills/tower/enemy/game_core/bonusStats/stage) 眩晕冻结(progress不动/不到达/计时递减)通过 STUN_DURATION=1固定. 备注: 工作区另有star/cross等未提交改动属他单范围,本单未动其他塔数值,仅修oval per2->per5对齐工单.
